verdict.rationale: Proton documents end-to-end encryption of every item field and offers a PGP-encrypted JSON export, so synced vault data and user-made backups are encrypted by the product itself. The pack never states that the vendor cannot hold the key, and it contains no encryption design documentation (key derivation, key hierarchy, or how the export PGP key is managed). Missing for 10: explicit zero-knowledge statement that Proton never holds the keys, published encryption design/whitepaper, details of export-key management, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a security engineer, backups are end-to-end encrypted with a key the vendor never holds, and the encryption design is documented

citations.quote: Proton Pass uses end-to-end encryption on every field you fill for the items you create (usernames, website addresses, and more).
the end-to-end encrypted password manager trusted by millions
